entities.note: 4x4 square (left half colour 9, right half colour 10) at rows 19-22, cols 39-42 = the right end of the corridor; 'big' (4x4, moves 4 px) until the SIZE spell shrinks it to 2x2 (moves 2 px)
5x6 framed door: colour-9 border with colour-10 fill at rows 17-22, cols 12-16, at the left end of the corridor; walking into it ends the level
the only walkable area: rows 19-22 for cols 23-38 (4 px tall) narrowing to a 2-px-tall NECK rows 19-20 for cols 17-22 that only the 2x2 player fits through
grey(5) fills everything that is not corridor; any move into it is refused (but still costs a step)

3x3 grid of 3x3-px cells at rows 49-51 / 54-56 / 59-61 x cols 24-26 / 29-31 / 34-36 inside a grey(3) frame rows 47-63, cols 22-38; unlit cells are colour 2, the four BLACK(0) cells (top-centre, middle-left, middle-right, bottom-centre) are the HINT = the diamond pattern of the SIZE spell; clicking a cell toggles it to colour 14

10x10 tile rows 50-59, cols 11-20 (grey border, colour-2 inside) showing a colour-15 diamond glyph = the icon of the only spell available at L1; clicking it re-selects the hint / replays the demo; free

cols 62-63, rows 0-63: colour 14 = remaining steps, black(0) eats in from the TOP (64 rows = 50 steps); moves and grid toggles cost 1, casts cost 1 extra; icon clicks, misclicks and the swallowed first action are free

rules.note: the very FIRST action of the level, whatever it is, is swallowed by a tutorial demo: the four hint cells light up one by one (about 22 frames), the player does not move and no step is charged
up 4 px when big (2 px when small; a blocked 4-px move retries 2 px); at L1 the corridor is only 4 tall so up/down are always blocked
down 4 px (2 when small); costs 1 step
left 4 px when big (2 px when small); the big player stops at col 23 where the neck begins
right 4 px (2 when small); costs 1 step
a move into grey wall is refused but still costs 1 step (same for ACTION1/2/4); the big 4x4 player cannot enter the 2-px neck at cols 17-22
clicking a grid cell (or its click pad) toggles that cell between unlit and colour 14; costs 1 step

when a toggle completes the diamond pattern (exactly the four hint cells lit) the SIZE spell casts inside the same action: cells flash colour 15, the player toggles 4x4 -> 2x2 (a second cast would grow it back if a 4x4 spot is free), the grid is cleared and 1 extra step is charged
clicking the spell-book tile only re-shows the hint (black cells) / replays the demo; free
a click anywhere else makes the grid flash colour 8 briefly; free

goal.note: a move whose collision touches the door ends the level; the player must first be shrunk (cast SIZE by lighting the 4 diamond cells) to pass the 2-px neck, then walk left into the door; minimum 13 actions (1 swallowed + 4 left + 4 toggles + 4 left)
